static_summary.scope: Eight final static snapshots, one per episode; repeated voxel-events across episodes are not unique global cells.

dynamic_direct_hits.denominator: Unique voxel/batch events; repeated cells across batches are not independent samples.

denominator: Static counts are voxel/episode observations; dynamic counts are repeated cell/batch events, not independent physical volumes.
changes: Only direct positive votes that would leave a cell FREE are neutralized to observed UNKNOWN. No miss, TTL, filter, ray, sampling or resolution change.
limitations: Visible 12mm object has zero selected rays and remains UNKNOWN.
Unhit prior FREE object interiors can remain FREE until TTL5 despite fresh global map health.
Most evaluated local volume remains UNKNOWN; sampled gaps do not certify continuous clearance.
Voxel boundaries mix object and air; strict false-OCCUPIED counts include nanometre-separated nominally touching cells.
USD rigid-body topology changes invalidate SDK pose views and require reinitialization.
The serial standalone 2Hz loop steps physics between mapping calls; it does not establish combined semantic/control runtime schedulability.
readiness: Validated as an independent occupancy-evidence provider for the next integration design. Consumer must preserve UNKNOWN, cell age and source-health distinctions; FREE is not a collision-clearance certificate. Runtime integration and planning remain unimplemented.
